_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Depot Maintenance Cost Report
summary: The Depot Maintenance Cost Report identifies the actual costs of depot maintenance to compare actual costs versus programmed costs and track completion status of tasks and items.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Depot Maintenance Cost Report identifies the actual costs of depot maintenance.
3.2 The data is used to compare actual costs versus programmed (contract) costs and in conjunction with periodic progress reports to ascertain the completion status of separately identified functional tasks and items.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
7.2 This DID is applicable to the acquisition of the actual costs of contractor provided depot maintenance.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Depot Maintenance Cost Report shall be in a contractor selected format. When consistent with an effective presentation, the contractor selected format used in the initial submission shall be used for subsequent submissions. A typical format for the Depot Maintenance Cost Report is shown at Figure 1.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Depot Maintenance Cost Report shall delineate the following data:

children.title: Identification of the Contractor or Government Activity including full name, address, and telephone number(s).
The SPECIFIC LOCATION of each end item.
The DEPOT LEVEL MAINTENANCE COSTS incurred (excluding repair parts costs) as a result of work performed to accomplish contractor depot level maintenance at each location.
The REPAIR PART NUMBER, QUANTITY, NOMENCLATURE, AND COSTS at each location.
The TOTAL COSTS for maintenance and parts at each location.
